src: data as of Oct 31, ~00:47 UTC · sources: CryptoTicker, 24/7 Wall St. (SoSoValue), Bitcoin News Digest, KuCoin · not financial advice

beats.say: About six point three billion dollars drained from Binance. Here's your crypto week.
beats.cap: ~$6.3B drained from Binance. Here's your crypto week.

beats.say: Bitcoin fell four percent on the week, near seventy-seven thousand. Ether lost over five percent.
beats.cap: BTC −4% on the week, near $77K. ETH lost >5%.

beats.say: TRM Labs blames North Korea's TraderTraitor. About three billion is frozen, and Binance says it will cover all losses.
beats.cap: TRM Labs blames North Korea's TraderTraitor. ~$3B frozen; Binance says it will cover all losses.
beats.text: Binance pledges to cover all losses

beats.say: Bitcoin ETFs lost two hundred two million on the week. Ether ETFs bled for eleven straight days.
beats.cap: BTC ETFs −$202M on the week. ETH ETFs bled 11 straight days.

beats.say: On the institutional side, Strive bought six thousand one hundred eighty-two Bitcoin, to about forty-three thousand.
beats.cap: Institutions: Strive bought 6,182 BTC, now ~43,000 BTC.

beats.say: Next week: U S midterms Tuesday, I S M services Wednesday, and the jobs report Friday.
beats.cap: Next week: US midterms Tue, ISM services Wed, jobs report Fri.

title: Binance loses ~$6.3B in a hack, Bitcoin −4% on the week: your crypto recap
caption:
the week in crypto 🗓️ ~$6.3b drained from binance (≈$3b frozen, binance says it will cover losses), btc −4% near $77.3k, eth −5.2%, btc etfs −$202m, eth etfs −$432m (11 straight days out), strive added 6,182 btc. next week: us midterms, ism, jobs report fri. not financial advice.
